notes.title: Announcing Remastered Version of Insurgence 1 & 2
notes.content:
Platomenti Studios and YSY Softworks partnered with CRX Entertainment Pte Ltd are pleased to announce the upcoming release of the Remastered version of Insurgence - Chains of Renegade and Insurgence - Second Assault.

The Remastered version of these two games is set to feature a brand new pixel rendering engine, providing players with even more vibrant and rich colors than ever before, bringing these games to life in a whole new way. In addition, the games will be localized to more languages, with more details on which languages to come soon.

For Insurgence - Chains of Renegade, the game will also feature all new music from SSCore, a music production studio from YSY Softworks. This in-house music production studio has collaborated with Platomenti Studios for this release, providing an entirely new soundtrack for players to enjoy as they progress through the game.

"We're thrilled to bring these two beloved games back to the forefront with the Remastered version," said a spokesperson for Platomenti Studios. "With the new pixel rendering engine and the addition of more languages, we're confident that players will love the new look and feel of the game. And with the all-new music from SSCore, we're confident that both new and returning players will have an unforgettable experience."

The Remastered version of Insurgence - Chains of Renegade and Insurgence - Second Assault will be available on PC, with a Steam release planned for the near future. The Steam page is now up for Wishlist, so fans of the series can show their support and stay up-to-date with the latest news on the upcoming release.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2327370/Insurgence__Chains_of_Renegade_Remastered/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2327380/Insurgence__Second_Assault_Remastered/


For more information on the Remastered version of Insurgence - Chains of Renegade and Insurgence - Second Assault, please visit the official website of Platomenti Studios or follow their social media pages.

notes.title: We're Returned! CZAR: Decision Join Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Greetings!
Our game was delayed since early 2020 due to the obvious reason. That being said, we hope that you and your relatives and friends are always in good health.

This year we are continuing our project and today, we are joining Steam Next Fest!
There are some new details added to the game demo, so if you played our game during the Autumn Fest 2020, you may try this new version and discover new features and scene added to our game.
We also welcome new players and we are happy to present CZAR: Decision Demo to you all!

notes.title: CZAR: Decision - Introduction, and progress
notes.content:
[strike]I'm kind of bad when starting something ... so what should I say first ... hmm ...[/strike]
Hello! I'm Galang, the one who leading this game. This is my first commercial game named CZAR: Decision. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641290/de61347edd420f5d061c9e912bd1bdddbc220513.jpg[/img]
I played games since 1998. Since then I found out that RPG is no different than movies or novel books, they tells something from comedic and simple to the dramatic and deep. Either it is intended or not, those story wise media were affecting [i]today me[/i]. Now, I want to make games in hope that not only entertaining, but also positively affect you as a players. So, this game I created is mostly from my experience and also from many other people experience, either I saw or they told it. 

So, what's the big deal with this game?

You play the role of a guy named Sagara. He and his friends, Raina and Isa, were involved in an incident sixth years ago where miasma burst out from the ruins, later the suspects were arrested. And today, even the suspects were arrested, the incident repeats ... Main topic of this game are about grudges and regrets.

2019 was a year of demo testing, and 2020 is a year of realization.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641290/fafef278375356a19fa5923eeb4935476aad48f6.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641290/c7d10b2e0dbc3660570c3418af1f57a9a6e553ad.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641290/b369bf13ad5ee11c44b15ed6cc095cf68ed008d6.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641290/621b38bd9327002ea73619185c8726661f3678d2.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641290/6e3d433841c1c4ae766fce8710fb982100a841d8.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641290/9cefffc682fbf76fe3f210205262dd891b9a3caa.jpg[/img][/url]

We currently doing mapping hope we can finish it at the end of the February to start finishing the main story.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36641290/b80bd5b05a4f5c5e527945021c481d3b9601f943.jpg[/img]

Stay tune for the next news update and Happy Chinese New Year.

Ciao!
